text: External harness audit tightened the pins: Zarr-Python 3.2.1 requires Python >=3.12 and NumPy >=2, so the reproducible matrix is now Python 3.12 + zarr 3.2.1 + nibabel 5.2.1 + numpy 2.2.6; the input half generated all five NIfTI fixtures successfully.
